note: Both sets hallucinate the Living Room finished floor height as 2'-3 1/2" instead of the visible 2'-9 1/2". Set B is superior because it correctly extracts key sheet metadata (Lot Number, Sheet Title) that Set A misses, and avoids Set A's category errors (e.g., claiming the Sheet Number 'A302' is the Mechanical Room's location, or grid line 'K' is the Centre Module's location). Set A is also noisier with redundant claims.
